This small plot of mine, I have been farming it for many years. It is only 0.27 hectares, so my family can manage the work. I went to the cooperative and got some fertilizer this year — not as much as I wanted, they were late again — but I will put a small amount of DAP and urea on this plot too, same as I did last year when the yield was decent. I have cow manure from my animals, so I will spread that as well; it costs me nothing and the soil likes it. For seed, I will use what I saved from last season, the local type. My neighbor tried some new seed once and it did not do well here, so I stick with what I know. I do not use chemicals for pests on this plot — they are too expensive and hard to find, and this crop does not have big pest problems like chat or vegetables. We depend on the rains here, there is no irrigation. My wife and children will help with the planting, weeding, and harvesting. We should need about 40 days of family work over the season. I will not hire anyone for this small piece; we can do it ourselves.
